errors.not_implemented: The hub declares {operation} in the contract but does not implement it yet.
errors.connection: Could not reach the hub. Check the connection and try again.

login.title: Sign in
login.setup_unknown: Could not ask this hub whether it still needs first-run setup. Sign in, or reload the page.

setup.title: Create the owner account
setup.intro: This hub has no account yet. Create the owner here, with the setup token the hub wrote when it started.
setup.where_title: Where to find the setup token
setup.where_body: The hub printed it once in its log when it started, and wrote it to setup-token.txt inside the data directory. On the reference stack:
setup.where_local: Running the hub outside Docker: the file is in your DATA_DIR (./data/setup-token.txt by default). A new token is generated on every restart until this account exists.
setup.token_hint: Paste it exactly; it is compared as a whole and never stored in the browser.
setup.username_hint: Lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore — 2 to 40 characters.
setup.workspace_hint: The name of the first workspace; "Default" when left empty.
setup.password_hint: {min} characters or more. It is never shown, logged or stored anywhere but as a hash.
setup.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
setup.submit: Create the account and sign in
setup.unattended: An unattended install can still set HUB_ADMIN_PASSWORD before the first boot; the hub then creates the owner itself and this screen never appears.

shell.segment_later: {name} arrives with its module in a later phase.

pane.resize: Resize the side pane (arrow keys resize, Home collapses, End expands)

sessions.empty: No sessions in this workspace yet. Start one with New chat.
sessions.reorder: Reorder {title} (Space to pick up, arrows to move)

new_chat.pick_agent: Pick the agent this chat talks to. The list is the hub's registry.
new_chat.no_agents: No agent is enabled on this hub. Install or enable one in Agent Manager.
new_chat.none_ready: No agent is ready. Hermes ships with the hub; if it reads "not installed", check that it is running, or install one from the catalog in

chat.pick_one: Pick a session from the list, or start a new chat.
chat.empty: No messages yet. Say something below.
chat.resynced: Reconnected; the transcript was reloaded from the hub.

composer.label: Message composer
composer.placeholder: Message the agent… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
composer.busy_hint: A run is active; your next message is queued behind it.

agents.limited: This agent runs through the process harness and is limited.

settings.global_note: This screen is hub-wide, outside the current workspace.

glass.label: Glass intensity
glass.hint: Translucency and blur of the floating chrome only; content stays solid.

display.local_only: Saved on this device only; the hub could not store the preference.

theme.intro: Theme and background of this device. The footer chip changes the same preference.
theme.reduced_note: If your system asks for reduced transparency or motion, the app honours it automatically.

devices.pair_intro: Pair a phone: scan the QR with the Majlis app, or type the code. The code expires in five minutes.
devices.pairing_expired: The pairing expired. Start a new one.

placeholder.later: {name} arrives with its module in phase {phase}. Nothing is hidden here.

providers.hint: The providers you added. A key is typed once here; every agent uses it.
providers.empty: No provider of this kind is configured.
providers.none: No providers yet. Add the first one and its models arrive with it.

provider.key_stored: [stored] — paste a new key to replace it
provider.label: Name

defaults.hint: One chat model and one coding model. Every agent inherits them unless it is pinned to something else.
defaults.no_models: No models yet. Add a provider key and the hub fetches its model list.
defaults.inheriting_hint: What each agent will use when a chat does not name a model.

ensembles.hint: Ensembles are created over the API for now; this tab lands with the rooms screens.

test.http_error: The provider answered with an error.

panel.no_models: No models yet. Refresh the model list first.

add.fetch_failed: The provider did not return a model list.
add.fetch_empty: The provider answered, but listed no models.
add.loopback: This address is loopback, and the hub runs in a container — it would reach the container itself, not your machine. Try {url}, and on a Linux host add extra_hosts: ["host.docker.internal:host-gateway"] to the stack.
